title: kringles ModPack
description: This Modpack has my personal mods and favorite mods that I use whenever I play Minecraft!
body: This is **my personal modpack** for whenever I play Minecraft. It has **shader support**, my own Resource Pack, and some Quality of Life mods. I use this modpack day to day and I'll update it whenever I want new mods and think they will be very useful for features useful for things like **PvP**, **SMP** Servers, etc. This Modpack also includes **controller support** for anyone who wants to use **controller**, another thing it includes is **Voxy** for the cool views! You might like this modpack for whether you are on a PvP server, an SMP server, and lots more! It's well **optimized** and ready for use! :)
